When restoring, it adopts the provided state, reconciles with the query's pre-fetch state ([`revertState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L571)), applies structural sharing via `replaceData`, updates query state ending with `fetchStatus: 'idle'`, and does not invoke `onSuccess` or `onSettled` fetch callbacks. - Refined [`fetchState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L740-L750) so existing error and failure count metadata are not reset during refetches. 3. **Observer Mount Handling:** - Updated [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L461-L479) so when `_optimisticResults === 'isRestoring'`, `fetchStatus` remains `'idle'` without triggering mount-time resets, retaining persisted failure counts and timestamp metadata. 4. **Independent Freshness Reconciliation:** - [`reconcileQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-core/src/persister.ts#L52-L161) merges data freshness and error freshness independently: - Data freshness: selects newer `data`, `dataUpdatedAt`, and `dataUpdateCount`. - Error freshness: selects newer `error`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdateCount`, and failure counters. - When both data and error are present in the reconciled result, `status` is set to `'error'`, ensuring `isRefetchError` evaluates to `true`. - Preserves `isInvalidated` and infinite-query `pages` and `pageParams`. 5. **Fine-Grained Persister Core Updates:** - Updated `experimental_createQueryPersister` in [`createPersister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L238-L244) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data: restoredData, state: restoredPersistedQuery?.state })`. - Updated [`restoreQueries()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jdwunza0/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L318-L343) in bulk restoration to reconcile with in-memory queries via `reconcileQueryState` or instantiate them directly in `queryCache` with `fetchStatus: 'idle'`. 6. **Testing & Verification:** -
